gt6ktfruaddon.structure.ore_processing_s: 6 across, 5 deep and 3 high. Controller at the front-left end of the bottom layer when facing the front, facing outward
Three columns on your left: titanium walls on the bottom, sluice parts in the middle, empty on top

Three columns on your right: tungstensteel walls on the bottom; middle is tungstensteel for the front two rows and centrifuge parts for the back three; top is shredder blades for the front two and centrifuge parts for the back three
The front tungstensteel wall on your right outputs items and fluids. The other titanium and tungstensteel walls are inputs. EU enters the controller

gt6ktfruaddon.water_mill.early: The water mill does not need a repair yet
Light module takes LU. Energy module takes EU and must stay satisfied.
The controller is the gap in front of the energy module.
Items enter the top of the controller and leave the back.
Walls and the IO manager also carry items and fluids.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.mask_aligner_uv_: Three layers: shell, motors and wafer platform, then UV+ lights.
The controller is the front gap. The energy module is behind it.
Items leave the top. Fluids leave the back.
LU enters the light modules. EU is the energy-module condition.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.mask_aligner_duv: The source map also asks for unregistered parts 31110 and 31120.
Those two cells are absent, so this shape is not the source shape.
The other cells are sunlight absorbers and one catalytic casing.
LU enters the controller. Items enter the top and leave the back.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.mask_aligner_euv: Same incomplete map as DUV. Parts 31110 and 31120 were never registered.
The controller is tungsten and accepts LU itself.
Items enter the top and leave the back.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.cnc_machine.1: Aluminium walls take EU. Platforms take items and fluids.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.cnc_machine.2: The motor and the cutter head are casings.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.cnc_machine.3: The controller is the front gap of the middle row.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.cnc_machine.4: Items enter the top and leave the bottom.
gt6ktfruaddon.sun_mirror.no_target: This mirror has no sun-heater target.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.large_gas_turbin: 3x3x4 turbine shell. Controller in the center of the front 3x3, facing outward.
The back center is the energy hatch. The lower back cell outputs fluid. The other shells carry fluid.
After the gas burns, RU is injected four blocks behind the controller.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.large_steam_turb: Same 3x3x4 as the gas turbine. The shell matches that gas-turbine tier.
Steam enters the controller tank. RU leaves the front.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.dynamo.1: Two 3x3 turbine-shell faces with two 3x3 slices of large copper coils between them.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.dynamo.2: Controller at the front center. RU enters the front. EU leaves the back.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.separate_excite_: Five 5x5 layers. Walls are dense steel. Coils are large copper coils.
Controller is the gap in the middle layer. RU enters the front, excite EU the top, and EU leaves the back.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.expanded_motor.1: Two 2x3 layers of wall. The controller is the corner.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.expanded_motor.2: Fuel passes through the structure. RU leaves the front.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.fluid_boiler.1: The middle slice is fixed at one. The source repeats it up to eight times.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.fluid_boiler.2: Heat pipes, pressure pipes and exchangers are casings. Aluminium D inputs and E outputs.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.fluid_boiler.3: The controller is the bottom center of the front layer.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.liquid_battery.1: Front 3x2 shell. Controller in the bottom center. Bottom row takes fluid, top row takes energy.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.liquid_battery.2: One air cell behind it, with bronze fluid-battery walls around and below. The source flood-fills up to the registered height and width.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.liquid_battery.3: RU enters the left, right, back and top. RU leaves the front. The 1 HU on the bottom is the required input.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.transform_batter: Seven 4x4 layers, AABBBCC. Controller at the bottom corner.
T and W are both the energy wall. One cell cannot match a transformer part or that wall. O is the coil, C the conductor, B the cabin.
Sealed energy stays in the controller. The EU coil is a large copper coil.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.research_assembl: Two layers. The bottom is a crafting table and steel walls. The top is three steel walls.
The controller is the gap in the first row of the bottom layer. The crafting table is a plain block.
EU 131072, packets 64-524288. Checks the research monitor two blocks behind before running a recipe.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.wireless_battery: Seven 4x4 layers, AABBBCC. Controller at the bottom corner.
T and C are magnetic conductors. O is a large copper coil. W is a titanium wall. B is a battery cabin.
While sealed and formed, it sends EU to the noted receivers. The receiver emits from the front.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.electromagnet_cr: Five 5x5 layers, ABBBC. The offset puts the controller in the bottom gap.
P is the crucible screen. X is a titanium wall. C is a large copper coil.
The bottom accepts 256-1024 EU. The known iron melts when the temperature crosses its melting point. Inserted items are not read.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.research_reactor: Same two-layer shell as the research assembler. EU 131072, packets 64-524288.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.optical_microsco: Three layers. C is a tank wall. G is glass. The controller is the bottom gap. 256 EU per item.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.electron_microsc: Three layers, offset -2,-1,0. C is a tank wall, S is a titanium wall, G is glass. 4096 EU per item.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.wireless_compute: 3x3x3. One middle layer. N is an aluminium wireless compute node. Reach is 512 blocks.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.wireless_battery: Seven 4x4 layers, AABBBCC. Same dimension, 64 blocks, 8 links, distance loss.
5x5 layers ABCCCDDDD. Cross-dimension, 32 links, no distance loss, quantum receivers only.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.fusion_tokamak_e: Layer rule 0123456, offset -8,0,0. EU 2048. The LU start charge is not applied.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.fusion_tokamak_t: Layer rule ABCDEFGGFEKLMM, offset -12,-1,0. EU 16384. The LU start charge is not applied.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.laser_fusion_exp: 7x7x7. LU packets 1-131072. No pulse buffer and no cooldown.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.laser_fusion_ind: 11x11x11. LU packets 1-2097152. No pulse buffer and no cooldown.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.catalytic_reacto: 5x5x5 ABCDE, offset -2,-1,0. EU 2048, packets 256-4096, cheap overclock.
Same shell as the EV reactor. EU 8192, packets 1024-16384, cheap overclock.
gt6ktfruaddon.structure.centrifugal_micr: 9x9x9 shell. Pays 2048 EU per tick and counts 600 ticks. World rules stay unchanged.
